aboutWhat: This page answers what this service is holding in memory that it could rebuild, and whether holding it is paying off. A cache is listed here by the module that owns it; a store whose entries cannot be rebuilt — a replay history, a session, an issued code — is a register and is not a cache, whatever its variable is called.
aboutFigures: Valid entries are still good. Expired ones are past their deadline, or were built from something that has since changed, and are still held because nothing has looked them up or pushed them out yet. The hit ratio is lookups answered from the cache over all lookups, since this process started. Every figure in the two tables is this process's own (pid {pid}): a request worker or another cluster node holds caches of its own, and what the other nodes report is in its own section below. Keys are shown and values never are.
aboutBound: Every store has a bound. For a store kept per trust realm it is per realm: Current size counts every realm, and the fullest realm is the figure to compare with it. A bound is either enforced — the store drops its oldest entry, or, for a replay history, refuses the new one rather than forget a live one — or structural, where the store cannot outgrow something else that is bounded, such as one key set per realm. Each row says which.
replayNote: These make a one-time value work once, so their entries cannot be rebuilt and none of them has a control. A hit here is a value found already held — for a replay history, a second use refused; for a nonce store, a nonce honoured — and each row says which. A store that refuses when full says so in its lifetime.
headNotListed: Not held by this process, and not listed
thWhyNot: Why it is not a row above
noOtherNodes: No other process's figures are visible: this service is not clustered, or no other node has published a report yet (a node publishes its first about five seconds after it joins).
nodeFigures: {host}, pid {pid}, {entries} entries, as of {age} s ago
otherNodesNote: Each node's front process publishes the sizes and counters of its caches on its cluster membership row every thirty seconds; this is the last each one published. Rows are not published, so a drill-down is always this process's own.
droppedRefusedSince: {evictions} dropped and {refusals} refused at it since this process started.
lookupsCounted: {hits} hit(s), {misses} miss(es) since pid {pid} started. A hit is {meaning}.
entriesOrder: The entries are ordered by deadline, soonest first; those with none come last.
holdsNothing: This cache holds nothing right now.
